mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Harriet Park with temperatures at 67 degrees. Tonight, the moon is full, and while the ISS is passing by, the cloud cover will prevent any viewing. The overnight low will be 49 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

City officials remind residents that Hwy M near the Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for road improvements. Additionally, fall leaf pickup begins citywide on October 5, so please keep leaf piles clear of obstacles and out of the street.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including Live Music at Bailey's Run and the Verona Fall Fest today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on September 5, officers investigated a series of reports regarding vehicles with cheese left on their windshields, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel. Please look forward to enjoying their classic flavors again once they reopen.
